title: Brushed Bronze Oval Combination Shower Basket - 18.75-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Shower Basket, Traditional Style, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep bottles and soap organized without cluttering your shower—this wall-mounted shower basket is backed by a limited lifetime warranty and built from solid brass for everyday bathroom use in Brushed Bronze, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms.

  • Brushed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Concealed screw mounting delivers a clean, finished look on the wall
  • Rust-proof solid brass wires are made to stand up to wet environments
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces to coordinate your traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Specs

  • Product type: Oval combination shower basket
  • Mounting: Wall mount (concealed screw mounting)
  • Material: Brass (solid brass wires)
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 18.75 x 2.25 x 4.13 in
  • Projection: 4.13 in
  • Product weight: 4.8 lb
  • Included: Basket and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: False
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
